meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把演示主题或现成网页变成可点击跳转的分支幻灯片,自带讲者备注
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要做一份能点击跳转、带讲者备注的演示,而普通幻灯片不够用
copy.tagline_en: Turn a topic or web page into a branching clickable deck with speaker notes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a clickable deck with speaker notes that plain slides can't deliver

howto.what: 把内容做成 HyperFrames 幻灯片：可导航的 deck，含分片揭示、分支、热点跳转和内建演讲者备注；也能把已有网页转成 deck。产出是可运行、可导航的 deck，不是渲染好的 MP4。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做 slideshow、演示文稿、路演 deck，或要求把某个页面转成 deck 时接管；若请求只是「presentation」这类相邻说法，它会先确认再动手。

say.text: 把这份产品介绍做成 HyperFrames 幻灯片
say.note: 它会先确认意图再开始搭建

say.text: 把这个网页转成幻灯片，保留原来的视觉和交互
say.note: 会尽量按原页面保真移植

say.text: 给这几页幻灯片加上演讲者备注和热点跳转
say.note: 备注只在演讲者模式可见

howto.what_en: Claude builds a HyperFrames slideshow: a navigable deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspots, and a presenter mode with speaker notes. It can also convert an existing page into a deck. Output is a deck, not an MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for a slideshow, presentation or pitch deck, or ask to convert a page into a deck; adjacent requests like "presentation" are confirmed first.

say_en.text: Turn this product intro into a HyperFrames slideshow
Convert this page into a deck, keeping its visuals and interactions
say_en.note: Source design and motion are preserved

say_en.text: Add speaker notes and hotspot jumps to these slides
say_en.note: Notes show only in presenter mode
